scope: Independent source review and synthetic unit tests before full fits; no historical matrix/snapshot values or recent outcome files loaded.

resolved_findings.issue: Transient dedent in for col in X prevented module compilation. Author corrected before v2 prepare/full fits; synthetic tests passed afterwards.

checks.name: OOF and booster count
checks.detail: Same seed/colsample/matrix is passed to final and all strict-prior inner predictors. Eight day blocks yield one final plus seven inner fits; training outcomes patch rejects other IDs or DB sessions.

checks.name: Native126 and seed42 identity
checks.detail: Before fitting, native126 effective125 projection, categorical data, labels, recipe and train identity are compared with sealed111. Completed seed42 artifacts require full prediction equality to126 and corrected1/7 equality to132; actual parity remains an execution-time check.

checks.name: Same fit for full and preweight plus serialization
checks.detail: A fitted predictor is reused across both prediction masks; portable model files are SHA checked and all validation predictions must remain byte-identical after loading. Failed or partial output is retained rather than accepted.

checks.name: Encoded entry domain
checks.detail: Explicit encoded path applies no second TE/coercion/fallback and checks column/started order, dates, numeric versus categorical dtypes and Inf. Raw path encodes once before this entry. Caller remains responsible for proving the encoding domain for any external snapshot.

checks.name: Fixed mixed6 comparison and seed estimand
checks.detail: Uses same annual/regime baseline lambda for both arms, same-seed/year transferred coefficients, 1/7 fixed addition, and mean of per-race losses across seeds rather than a new average-probability model.

checks.name: Parent independent numerical auditor
checks.detail: Result completeness is required before any labels are scored; a unique winner is additionally required for NLL. DNF receives zero only on complete races. Head losses are horse-pooled; day bootstrap resamples numerator and denominator, with seed losses averaged before resampling. No concrete formula/population defect found; the auditor was not run on incomplete real outputs.
